sloka: ततो गोदावरीम् गत्वा नदीम् नर वर आत्मजौ ।उदकम् चक्रतुः तस्मै गृध्र राजाय तौ उभौ ॥३-६८-३५॥
transliteration: tato godāvarīm gatvā nadīm nara vara ātmajau ।udakam cakratuḥ tasmai gṛdhra rājāya tau ubhau ॥3-68-35॥

translations.english: Then both the princes went down to river Godavari and offered libations for the king of vultures.
